sql.propToolIncentive.getAllForCompany: select i.id, i.incentive, i.company_id, i.archived from props.incentive i where i.company_id = :companyId and i.archived is not true order by i.incentive
sql.propToolIncentive.update: update props.incentive set incentive = :incentive where id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.delete: update props.incentive set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
